changeSet.author: oe
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO clinlims.log10_default_upgrade (component_id, previous_version, applied_version) SELECT c.id, c.last_updated, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM clinlims.test_result_component c JOIN clinlims.test t ON t.id = c.test_id WHERE t.guid = 'b50d156e-0f6f-40cd-921c-4e831602a623' AND c.is_primary = true AND c.is_active = 'Y' AND c.result_type IN ('N', 'A') AND c.display_log10 = false AND c.log10_source_component_code IS NULL AND c.last_updated <= (SELECT dateexecuted FROM databasechangelog WHERE id = '146-explicit-log-display' AND author = 'oe'); UPDATE clinlims.test_result_component c SET display_log10 = true, last_updated = b.applied_version FROM clinlims.log10_default_upgrade b WHERE c.id = b.component_id;
